Amira Solano: hi folks! Amira here 04, joining product analytics from barcelona. big on rock climbing, late-night empanada experiments, and terrible puns. usually WFH but hoping to visit SF office later this year. :climbing:

Jonah Reed: welcome Amira!! love empanadas. FYI our office has a climbing route map (very unofficial) tacked by the whiteboard. :mountain:

HR Bot: Welcome Amira! Please complete the benefits form and upload your ID here: https://redwood.company/onboard/727890 (automated message)

Amira Solano: thanks! tiny Qs: where are the best recycling bins in the office? also, is there a quiet room for calls?

Priya Nair: recycling is by the mail wall and under the big plant near kitchen B. quiet rooms are bookable in the calendar as "focus pods"; theres a 30-min grace rule if someone forgot to extend.

Samira Khan: also welcome! if youre into plant swaps, bring a cutting  we do monthly swaps in the kitchen. and re: empanadas, recipe swap pls. :heart_eyes:

Amira Solano: will bring empanada photos and maybe a tiny sourdough-empanada hybrid. :) also, quick VPN note for remote folks:
```
redwood-vpn connect --user amira.s --profile remote-default
```
worked for me after MFA. thanks for the warm welcome!
